subject.title: fix(config): warn when JSON5 comments are lost on config write

question: Should ConfigWriteResult and ConfigReplaceResult permanently expose a singular optional warning field for comment loss?
rationale: The bug fix needs a quiet-mode diagnostic, but choosing a new exported result shape is a compatibility-sensitive API decision rather than a correctness detail automation can settle.

options.title: Keep the optional warning fields
options.body: Approve the additive structured contract, retain the focused tests, and require public-path proof before merge.

options.title: Use an established diagnostic collection
options.body: Replace the singular fields with an existing shared warning or diagnostic result shape if config APIs already have a canonical pattern.

options.title: Keep warnings log-only
options.body: Remove the result fields and accept that skipOutputLogs callers will not receive the comment-loss diagnostic.

recommendation.title: Keep the optional warning fields
recommendation.body: Approve the additive structured contract, retain the focused tests, and require public-path proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent config-preservation work makes this the strongest available owner for the exported result-contract decision.
